A digital device operates with discrete values (typically 0 and 1, or on/off states), not continuous signals.  

- (A) Regulator of a fan — usually varies voltage continuously (analog control).  
- (B) Microphone — converts sound to continuous electrical signals (analog).  
- (C) Resistance of a material — analog property.  
- (D) Light switch — either on or off (discrete states), so it is digital in nature.  

Final answer: (D)
